purpose: Teach: 予見/告訴/蒸留/沈没/演算/概略/諜報/内政

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合の動きを予見して先回りしろ
lines.en: Anticipate the competition's moves and stay ahead of them.
lines.style: Direct, measured command. Clipped consonants on key words. No warmth — authority speaking to competence. Eyes level, brief pause after each clause.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。風評被害には告訴も視野に入れます
lines.en: Yes. We're also considering legal action for any reputational damage.
lines.style: Steady, professional acknowledgment. Slight formality in the rhythm — reporting upward. Clear on the commitment. No flourish, just competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、香料の蒸留精製を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our fragrance distillation and refinement capabilities.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Each noun lands with weight. No elaboration — assumes understanding. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外プロジェクトの沈没を防ぐ対策をしております
lines.en: Yes. We're already implementing measures to prevent the overseas project from collapsing.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Slightly faster pace to show readiness. The reassurance of work already underway. Professional but not stiff — he's handled this.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、データ演算サーバを更新しろ
lines.style: Crisp, non-negotiable directive. Slight emphasis on 'update' — efficiency matters. Brief as commands are. The tone assumes it will be done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事業の概略を株主総会で説明します
lines.en: Yes. I'll explain the business overview at the shareholder meeting.
lines.style: Clear commitment. Grounded, professional tone. Takes the responsibility seriously without overselling. Steady eye contact, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、産業諜報には厳重に警戒しろ
lines.en: Maintain strict vigilance against industrial espionage.
lines.style: Grave, measured warning. Careful enunciation on 'espionage' — the weight of the threat. Not aggressive, but unmistakably serious. This is not negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。各国の内政情勢を分析しております
lines.en: Yes. We're analyzing the political and economic conditions across key markets.
lines.style: Methodical, professional. Slightly formal register. The tone of someone already deep in the work, reporting completion. Steady, no defensiveness.
